summary: Tesla winding down Cybertruck production (861 HN points) and OpenAI's fresh $11B raise at a $1.25T valuation dominate the non-phone slots, while phone news leans on Apple's DOJ antitrust fight, a one-less-button iPhone rumor, and the Oppo Find X10 Ultra's reported cancellation. 7/10 picks are phone (70%).
